Focused tests passed for incompatible flags, unusable bases, malformed or unreadable metadata, path aliases, hidden index entries and cancellation. Invalid eligibility widens to full execution with a reason; incompatible invocation flags return exit 2.
The producer-to-delivery-reader boundary is directly tested. Dedicated carried-record seal, verify and closeout coverage remains the accepted low-priority F1 gap.

Examined CLI parsing, schema additions and the delivery consumer. Carry is opt-in, old records retain their meaning, and records without engine_version cannot become carry bases. The selfContained extension is specified and documented.

Independently passed go -C pose-mcp test ./internal/cli -run 'Carry|ChangedScope|Validate|Material|Cancellation' -count=1 and the direct delivery-parser test. Examined selection, chained origins, preserved failures, missing prior results and cleanliness invalidation. Full build and matrix coverage relies on the supplied sealed evidence.

D1 addresses the inability of partial changed-scope records to replace canonical evidence: a complete result retains each reused observation's actual origin. D2 conservatively rejects matrix or engine changes; D3 makes narrower root-change behavior explicit. The cheapest stale-reuse shortcut is representing an old observation as newly executed; carried_from and the delivery reader preserve its origin, and dirty-base tests reject invalid reuse. The corpus has no dedicated carried-record seal/closeout case; N63 records that assurance gap.

The runtime paths, tests, help, manuals and ADR implement the approved carry scope. The unavailable-binding change matches current R2. The delivery declaration identifies the production validate entrypoint, and surface-check found one target with zero findings.

Examined revision confinement before Git calls, dependency containment, physical aliases, symlinks, hidden index flags, submodules and administrative exclusions. Focused negative tests passed. Carry retains the existing local validation-record trust boundary and introduces no external execution authority.

Reusing changed-scope selection and comparing the whole matrix and engine is smaller than per-command caching or arbitrary input hashing. Refusing every unavailable binding would disable legitimate reuse without strengthening the independent material_clean witness. This choice becomes insufficient when checks depend on undeclared inputs outside the selection model.
